arguments.summary: Fixed-evidence draft: NVDA has the stronger 63-session relative tape and a guided AI-infrastructure demand bridge, while MU has a nearer, binary FY26 Q4 completion test with substantially higher realized volatility. QQQ diversifies single-issuer risk but retains material dated NVDA/MU exposure. The grids are useful conditional sensitivities, not fair values or forecasts. No unconditional preference is supported because issuer multiple history/forward earnings, a defined macro regime, and quantified policy exposures are missing.

claims.text: NVDA reported H1 FY27 GAAP diluted EPS of $4.85 and guided Q3 revenue of $108bn ±2%, 74% GAAP gross margin ±50bp, explicitly assuming no China Data Center compute revenue. The $8/$10/$12 FY27 EPS scenarios leave constant-share Q3+Q4 residuals of $3.15/$5.15/$7.15; respectively they test deceleration, guided completion plus Q4 continuation, and sustained ramp upside. The associated 20x/25x/30x multiples and all outcomes are assumptions.

Against NVDA's 2026-09-18 split-adjusted close, the assumed bear/base/bull grid produces -28.02%/+12.48%/+61.97% sensitivities. Base breaks even at 22.227x on assumed $10 EPS, or $8.8908 assumed EPS at 25x. Separately, NVDA returned 5.50% over 63 sessions, 8.08 percentage points ahead of QQQ, but had higher 63-session realized volatility (39.63% versus 20.85%). This is conditional valuation math plus descriptive market behavior, not a forecast.

MU reported nine-month FY26 GAAP diluted EPS of $41.40 and guided Q4 GAAP EPS of $30.73 ±$1.00. The assumed $65/$72/$78 annual EPS cases imply constant-share Q4 residuals of $23.60/$30.60/$36.60; base approximately completes guidance, bear tests memory demand/pricing or margin weakness, and bull requires an above-guidance AI-memory outcome. The 10x/14x/18x multiples are assumptions, not observed issuer multiples or consensus.

Against MU's 2026-09-18 split-adjusted close, the assumed bear/base/bull grid produces -36.01%/-0.77%/+38.22% sensitivities. Base breaks even at 14.1083x on assumed $72 EPS, or $72.5571 assumed EPS at 14x. MU's -10.42% 63-session return lagged QQQ by 7.83 points and its 89.56% realized volatility exceeded NVDA and QQQ; its recent rebound does not erase mandate-window lag.

QQQ's sponsor-reported aggregate P/E was 30.08 as of 2026-08-31. Its dated 2026-09-18 equity holdings included NVDA at 8.535228% and MU at 5.012336%, or 13.547564% combined before other semiconductor holdings. Thus QQQ diversifies the two single-company paths but retains direct theme exposure; its aggregate sponsor P/E cannot validate or be directly compared with assumed corporate scenario P/Es.

NVIDIA's guidance already excludes China Data Center compute revenue, while its filing identifies export-control barriers and Taiwan/South Korea supply dependence. Micron discloses unquantified risks from trade restrictions, tariffs, equipment/components/raw-material access and unresolved investigations. These mechanisms can impair demand, availability or margins, but supplied evidence does not quantify comparable financial exposures; QQQ can transmit each through its dated holdings.

NVDA's stronger 63-session performance and lower realized volatility than MU coincide with a base case requiring Q3 guided execution plus Q4 continuation; MU's base case is more immediately testable at its scheduled Q4 result but has almost no selected-multiple cushion. QQQ is broader but contains dated direct positions in both. This establishes differing risk structures, not a preferred instrument, because the arbitrary scenario multiples, absent forward evidence, macro regime and policy quantification prevent a defensible valuation-adjusted ranking.

gaps.description: No issuer multiple history, forward earnings/consensus, or comparable corporate valuation methodology is supplied. This prevents determining whether either assumed P/E band is fair, normal or more attractive than QQQ's aggregate sponsor metric, invalidating an unconditional relative-preference conclusion.

No dated yield/inflation/credit-spread observation paired with customer order or capex evidence is supplied. The prevailing macro regime and its valuation/demand transmission cannot be identified, preventing a macro-adjusted preference.

Current rule status and quantified issuer-specific policy exposure are absent: NVIDIA license/applicability and Micron geography/product/input sensitivity are not established. Policy loss estimates and policy-based ranking are blocked, though disclosed risk mechanisms remain usable conditionally.

assumptions: All scenario EPS and P/E values in e52/e53 are explicit analyst assumptions, not consensus, observed multiples, fair values, probabilities or forecasts.
Residual EPS calculations use a constant diluted-share approximation; fiscal periods exceed the 63-session research horizon.
QQQ holdings/valuation are dated sponsor data, not current holdings; QQQ aggregate P/E and company scenario P/Es have non-equivalent bases.
arguments.counter_thesis: Continued AI infrastructure and memory demand could exceed guidance and overcome assumed multiple compression; alternatively, both companies can meet operational assumptions while valuation multiples decline. QQQ's diversification reduces single-company event concentration but does not remove correlated AI/semiconductor exposure.

review_conditions.description: Review NVDA after its next results: revenue/margin or forward outlook below the Q3-guidance-plus-Q4 residual mechanism weakens the $10 EPS/25x base; corroborated sustained ramp and Q4 support weakens the bear mechanism.

Review MU at its scheduled fiscal Q4 release: a material miss to $30.73 ±$1.00 guidance or the $30.60 base residual weakens the base completion mechanism; delivery with sustained margin/outlook supports it.
Refresh QQQ holdings and aggregate valuation before using diversification/look-through conclusions: changed NVDA/MU weights or aggregate P/E changes the direct overlap comparison.

NVDA.counter_thesis: Demand/mix or margin deceleration, export/supply disruption, or multiple compression can defeat the bridge even if Q3 revenue is delivered.
